comparison.objective: Translate one bar 5 cm, rotate another by a quarter turn, and leave a third unchanged; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Measured rigid-body translation/rotation and selective non-interference versus coaxial tooling, bimanual impact control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Specified bar displacements with the third untouched versus four safe fractures, contained tangs, retained inserts, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Pose-setting tests differ from contact-driven notch fracture and containment. No spec versions or pose tolerances are available beyond the stated target amounts.
